meta.title: Subscription status (for dmx-pushit-subscribe status-url)
meta.description: Read-only check: active push_subscriptions row for the logged-in user. Wappler: leave Output ON for the query step.

flow.name: yourPortal
flow.comment: Use session identity in the query WHERE, e.g. {{yourPortal.identity}}

flow.name: findActive
flow.comment: Output ON in Wappler so you can see the step result in the API designer.

notes: Pair with status-url on dmx-pushit-subscribe. Component POSTs { userUUID, entityId?, endpoint? }.
No extra Set Value step required — dmx-pushit-subscribe v1.2.9+ reads findActive.active === 1 as subscribed.
Optional: add a final Set Value / Response with { subscribed: true/false } if you prefer that shape.
Compare active to number 1 in SQL (TINYINT), not boolean true.
For sending: query the same table in your notify APIs before PuSH-IT Send.
